content.comment_body: Thank you for your response. Is there a way to store data from the [product_name] web editor in an SQL database? Thanks, [user_name]
Currently, I am not aware of any method to connect a [product_name] PLC directly to a database.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in linking [product_name] Web Editor data with SQL databases, indicating a need for integration with backend systems. Replies show that there is currently no straightforward way to achieve this, either due to product limitations or a lack of clear documentation. This highlights a gap between user needs for data integration and what is currently supported by the [product_name] platform.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] Web Editor to have a simple and direct method to store its data in an SQL database for easier integration with external systems.
